doctrine_ref: v2 §2 gate 4 + case_12 outlier; Master Plan §2 pillar F (classify-first, never system name)
rationale: A one-row contact lookup keyed to a historical identifier is not a statistical profile: shape (rows=1, hash join key) classifies it as a lookup, so the treatment is DELETE, not ANONYMIZE. System name must never decide treatment.
request_summary: Synthetic subject changed email once. An analytics record with exactly one row is keyed to the OLD email hash and carries an opt-in flag.
title: Historical-hash lookup: one-row analytics record keyed to an old email hash
